aiVerification.summary: Draft is not usable because it treats the filename as the changed factor and misgroups the NG-vs-OK dimension comparison.
issues: Changed factor should not be the filename.
Baseline/test conditions are unclear or wrong.
Header row is converted into invalid measurement stats.
NG rate inspection outcome is omitted.
Decision row is not cited in final evidence.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to sample status: NG gap coil/sup sample vs OK sample.
Use rows 13-15 and 17-26 for dimension comparison evidence.
Remove header-derived aggregate stats from row 15.
Add NG rate check from rows 7-11 as a separate outcome under same report context.
Cite decision row 36 for conclusion support.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are incomplete and partly misused; row-level evidence is not yet sufficient.
